9203.html:
9203 bāṇá (bā́ṇa- AV.) m. 'reed-shaft, arrow' RV. 2. vāṇá-¹ m. 'arrow, pipe', vāṇī́- f. 'reed' RV. [Cf. *vāṇa-². — Differing Austro-as. sources suggested by J. Przyluski BSL xxv 56 and PMWS 34. — → Par. bânȫ, bânug 'arrow' IIFL i 240]
    1. Pa. Pk. bāṇa- m. 'arrow'; Kal.rumb. bᵘŕə̃ 'arrowhead'; K. bān m. 'arrow', S. ḇāṇu m., L. P. bāṇ m., Ku.gng. bā̃ṛ̃ə, A. B. bān, Or. bāṇa (whence bāṇuā 'hunter'), Bi. bān, OAw. bāna m., H. bān, m., G. bāṇ n., M. bāṇ m., Si. baṇa.
    2. P. vāṇ m. 'arrow'.
    bāṇāsana-; *antarabāṇa-.
    Addenda: bāṇa-: WPah.kṭg. bāṇ m. 'arrow'.
    BĀDH: †sáṁbādhatē.

3164.html:
3164 kím n.sg. 'what? why?', interrogative particle RV., kiṁ vā 'or whether' Mn. [ká-²]
    Pa. kiṁ 'what?', kiṁ . . . udāhō 'whether . . . or', Aś. jau. kiṁ, gir. ki, kb. kiṁmaṁ 'why so?' < kim ēvam, NiDoc. ki, Pk. kiṁ, ki pron. and interr. particle, Dm. kya, Tir. ki, Gaw. kī, Kal. kīa, Kho. ki 'which? (of animals and things)', Mai. gī, Phal. ga, K. kyā, rām. ḍoḍ. kī 'why?', S. ki interr. particle; P. kī interj. 'what!', kī . . . kī 'whether . . . or'; WPah. bhal. paṅ. khaś. kī, Ku. kyā, N. ki 'interr. particle, or', kina 'why?', kyā, 'what?'; A. B. Or. Mth. OAw. ki 'what?, or'; H. ki . . . ki 'whether . . . or', kyā 'what?'; OMarw. kyaü, kyu, G. kiyũ; M. kī˜ 'or' (separate from kī˜ conj. 'that' ← H. ki ← Pers. LM 209); Si. ki- in cmpds. such as kikala 'what time?', kikaruṇa 'why?'.
    kimártham, kím u, kiṁkara-, kíṁcid, kiṁnara-, kiṁnāman-, *kiṁvēlaka-.
    Addenda: kím: Kho. also khi 'which?' BKhoT 70 (whence h?), Md. kiek, kīk 'what?'.

3271.html:
3271 kútaḥ 'whence?' RV., 'where?' R. [ka¹-]
    Pa. kutō 'whence?', Aś. dh. jau. kute, Pk. kuō; Kho. kur 'where?'.
    Addenda: kútaḥ: Kho. *kur in kurā 'where', na kurā 'nowhere', kuri 'whither' with loc. suffix -ā or -i BKhoT 70; S.kcch. ko 'why?'.

3384.html:

    Pk. kuha, Ash. kū̃, Phal. gō, Si. ko; — altern. NIA. words < kvà, Pa. kuva: but direct derivation is unlikely.
    Addenda: kúha [< *kudha cf. Ir. Shgh. kād < *kudā EVSh 40]

11363.html:
11363 vartís n. 'journey (= mārga- Mahīdh.)' RV. [√vr̥t¹]
    Gy. pers. vātī 'path', L. vāṭ, pl. vaṭī˜ f.; Si. väṭi-ya 'dam between fields serving as a path' (or < vártra- ?), väṭu 'path'. — See vártman-.
    vartīra- see vártikā-.
